name: Do Day Dream Public Company Limited
summary: Do Day Dream Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and distributes skin care products and supplements in Thailand. It offers its skin care products under the NAMU LIFE brand name. The company, as an original equipment manufacturer, also manufactures and advices in various kinds of skin care products, including cosmetics, such as creams, serums, gels, sprays, mists, masks, etc. In addition, the company provides management, technical, financial, and enterprise services. The company was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand.
